about: Job profiles. A profile names the mode, the skills and the MCP server variants that one kind of job or session may load. Nothing else is loaded. `verify` refuses a profile that breaks the rules of its mode (toolchain.json, modes).

agent-intake.title: Intake parser
agent-intake.summary: Turns the scanned issue text into a schema-valid spec. It has no tools and sees no repository, so this profile is empty on purpose and the loader must hand it nothing.

agent-planner.title: Planner
agent-planner.summary: Plans the change from the spec and a read-only clone, with offline Fabric documentation.

agent-test-author.title: Test author
agent-test-author.summary: Writes the declarative oracle tests from the spec before anything is implemented. It never sees the implementation.

agent-implementer.title: Implementer
agent-implementer.summary: Changes item definitions inside its own clone and runs the static gates locally. It cannot push, call Fabric or see the hidden checks.

agent-verifier.title: Verifier
agent-verifier.summary: Judges the diff against the spec and the sanitized evidence. Tool-less and read-only, so this profile is empty on purpose.

executor-static-gates.title: Static gate runner
executor-static-gates.summary: Runs the static gates (K6) without a Fabric credential. It validates local model files with the read-only authoring server and reads the offline documentation.

executor-sandbox-read.title: Sandbox reader
executor-sandbox-read.summary: Reads the sandbox workspace for read-back checks and reconciliation (K7, K10) with a workload identity. Every write is a typed executor operation, not an MCP call.

dev-docs.title: Documentation only
dev-docs.summary: The smallest useful start: offline Fabric documentation and Microsoft Learn, with no skill and no sign-in.

dev-fabric.title: Fabric development
dev-fabric.summary: All Fabric and Power BI skills and the Fabric MCP servers, signed in as yourself, for a sandbox workspace.

dev-powerbi.title: Power BI authoring (local server)
dev-powerbi.summary: Semantic models and reports, with the local authoring server and Fabric IQ for questions over what is deployed.

dev-powerbi-hosted.title: Power BI authoring (hosted server)
dev-powerbi-hosted.summary: The same work with the hosted authoring server in place of the local one. Use one or the other, not both.

dev-realtime.title: Real-Time Intelligence
dev-realtime.summary: Eventhouse, Eventstreams, event schemas and Activator.

dev-azure.title: Azure infrastructure
dev-azure.summary: The Azure skills with the Azure and Bicep MCP servers, read-only until you choose otherwise.

dev-factory.title: Working on the factory itself
dev-factory.summary: Everything a person needs to build and review the factory: all Fabric, Power BI and Azure skills, the Fabric servers, the Azure server in read-only form, and Learn. The project-level MCP files of this repository are rendered from this profile.
